frozen.title: 合成 Word 合同标题

text_sequence: 合成 Word 合同标题

cases.name: baseline
cases.reason: Title title; native direct Heading1 section; all original blanks; equal exact-ratio frames

cases.name: rounded_each_axis_1emu
cases.reason: One EMU rounding in each axis reaches exact w+h ratio tolerance

cases.name: inner_delta_1emu
cases.reason: Inner frame differs by one EMU on each axis and still passes ratio bounds

cases.name: explicit_transform_defaults
cases.reason: Integer rotation zero and XML on-off false/off defaults are allowed

cases.name: title_heading1
cases.reason: Article title must not use Heading1

cases.name: extra_body_heading1
cases.reason: An ordinary body paragraph must not become an extra Heading1

cases.name: extra_body_heading2
cases.reason: An ordinary body paragraph must not use any Heading style

cases.name: leading_heading1
cases.reason: Leading blank paragraph must not be a heading

cases.name: image_paragraph_heading2
cases.reason: Image-only paragraph must not be a heading

cases.name: body_direct_outline9
cases.reason: Even explicit body-level outline9 is forbidden on ordinary body

cases.name: missing_native_heading1
cases.reason: Heading1 reference cannot rely on a missing native definition

cases.name: native_wrong_name
cases.reason: Style ID alone cannot impersonate native Heading1

cases.name: native_wrong_type
cases.reason: Native Heading1 must be a paragraph style

cases.name: native_custom_style_true
cases.reason: A customStyle true definition cannot impersonate native Heading1

cases.name: native_wrong_outline
cases.reason: Native Heading1 needs its own outline level zero

cases.name: duplicate_native_style
cases.reason: Duplicate style IDs make heading resolution ambiguous

cases.name: native_missing_base
cases.reason: Native Heading1 basedOn chain must resolve

cases.name: native_basedon_cycle
cases.reason: Native style ancestry must have no cycle

cases.name: body_inherited_heading
cases.reason: An ordinary body cannot inherit a heading through basedOn

cases.name: docdefaults_outline9
cases.reason: Document paragraph defaults cannot hide outline9

cases.name: default_style_inherited_outline9
cases.reason: Default Normal ancestry cannot hide an outline level

cases.name: body_runstyle_heading
cases.reason: Body run style cannot reference a heading or hide its outline

cases.name: src_rect_all_zero
cases.reason: Any srcRect element is forbidden, including all-zero crop

cases.name: aspect_distorted_0p1_percent
cases.reason: A 0.1 percent width distortion exceeds integer aspect tolerance

cases.name: inner_delta_2emu
cases.reason: Two EMU frame mismatch is forbidden even when both aspect tests pass

cases.name: missing_inner_extent
cases.reason: Image transform must provide its own positive extent

cases.name: anchor_image
cases.reason: Only inline embedded images are supported

cases.name: rotation_nonzero
cases.reason: Nonzero rotation is forbidden

cases.name: flip_true
cases.reason: A true flip is forbidden

cases.name: transform_unknown
cases.reason: Unknown rotation and XML on-off flip syntax are forbidden

cases.name: fake_namespace_outline_attribute
cases.reason: Native outline value must use the true Word namespace

cases.name: styles_with_effects_part
cases.reason: An alternate stylesWithEffects part is outside the common contract

cases.name: inherited_hidden_text
cases.reason: Ordinary body text must not inherit vanish hidden text

cases.name: tiny_ratio_integer_boundary
cases.reason: 2x1 pixels with 7x2 EMU has D=3=w+h; inclusive exact integer boundary

cases.name: tiny_ratio_integer_outside
cases.reason: 2x1 pixels with 8x2 EMU has D=4>w+h; reject one integer beyond boundary

cases.name: missing_styles_relationship
cases.reason: Word requires exactly one canonical internal styles relationship

cases.name: duplicate_styles_relationship
cases.reason: Two otherwise valid styles relationships are ambiguous

cases.name: external_styles_relationship
cases.reason: External styles relation is forbidden even with the canonical target name

cases.name: noncanonical_styles_relationship
cases.reason: Internal target must be exactly styles.xml rather than a normalized alias
